records.raw_text: Tables 2-3: Monthly Gross Revenue data for franchised outlets: Muskego WI ($690,699 total), Sioux Falls SD ($256,471), Clearwater FL ($25,853), Omaha NE ($1,132,636), Lincoln NE ($746,873), Cedar Rapids IA ($464,024), Crystal Lake IL ($674,071)
records.notes: 81 monthly revenue data points from 7 franchised outlets. Outlets range from 4-59 months in business. Clearwater location includes data point with inconsistent months-in-business value (shows 0 for 9/24 entry). Average calculated from 3,990,627 total revenue across 81 data points.

notes: Item 19 present with franchisee revenue data. Document states representations derived from franchisees only. Company-owned outlet data (Table 1, 3 locations) also shown but not primary Item 19 representation per FDD text.
